# Form Items: Form Item Aggregates by Document Type

Area overview and notes: [form-items.md](../form-items.md)

`GET /form-items/aggregates/{documentType}` · tenant-scoped token

Retrieve a comprehensive snapshot of form item totals specific to a defined document_type. This API provides total row count, total proceeds, and total cost basis for the specified document type between a start and end date or a start and end disposed date. Only either of the date filters can be used.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `documentType` | The document for which the form item data totals are retrieved. One of: `1099_B`, `1099_DA`. |

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `end_date` | string (date-time) | No | End date for filtering form-items. |
| `end_disposed_date` | string (date-time) | No | End disposed date for filtering form-items. |
| `start_date` | string (date-time) | No | Start date for filtering form-items. |
| `start_disposed_date` | string (date-time) | No | Start disposed date for filtering form-items. |

**Response 200**: Successful response.

**Shape 1: 1099-B Aggregate Response**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `document_type` | string | Yes | Type of the tax document the form data is for, which determines the fields returned. One of: `1099_B`, `1099_DA`. |
| `record_count` | number | Yes | Total number of rows. |
| `proceeds` | string (decimal) | Yes | Total proceeds for the form-items. |
| `cost_basis` | string (decimal) | Yes | Total cost basis for the form-items. |

**Errors:** 400 Bad Request · 429 Too Many Requests
